experiment: N3COND B4: one fixed shrink with C0's simultaneous gain, against a sham and against the already-run C0

seeds.not: Already used for C0, C1, and B3. Not a fresh holdout. No cell may be called unbiased.

hypothesis.one_sentence: Keep the scalar gain that C0 fits to simultaneous probes, and only shrink steep coordinates by at most 2x.
hypothesis.why_this_one: B3 beat its own sham and lost to C0 because the axial median set a gain about 10-50x larger than C0's simultaneous gain. This batch removes that confound. The floor stays 0.5. It is not re-tuned.
hypothesis.not_included: No L1 cell. The confound to remove is the L3 gain explosion. Adding L1 would be a second surface.

arms.S0: Sham. One axial pass per start is charged and discarded, so lambda=1. The gain is then C0's simultaneous-probe gain on sigma0.
arms.S2: Shrink. The same axial pass sets lambda_j = clip(median(g)/g_j, 0.5, 1). The gain is C0's simultaneous-probe gain on the shrunk sigma, not on the axial median.
arms.C0: Audited reuse of the existing ordinary runs. Not re-queried. 8 simultaneous calibration queries per start, no axial pass, K=379, Q=3072, gain_frozen false.

allocation.why_K_differs: Nov3 has 12 coordinates and QAOA has 6, so the axial pass costs 24 versus 12. The S2-versus-S0 contrast matches K inside a circuit. C0 has K=379 because it has no axial pass.
allocation.gain: a = 0.5*(26)**0.602 / median(|simultaneous component|), probes taken at the sigma that is stepped. Axial numbers do not enter a.
allocation.init: same four starts as C0, keyed by circuit id

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. Fidelity is post hoc and is not in the gate.

gate.dE_C0: E(S2)-E(C0). Negative means S2 is lower than the ordinary C0.
gate.dE_S0: E(S2)-E(S0). Negative means S2 is lower than the sham.
gate.pass_one_N: median dE_C0 < 0 AND the bootstrap 95% CI of the mean dE_C0 is entirely below 0 AND median dE_S0 < 0
gate.branch_survives: pass_one_N at both N9 and N12
gate.on_fail: Close scale/gain conditioning. Do not scan another floor. Do not start N15.
gate.on_pass: Read-dev only. Not an adoption. Not a fresh-holdout result. GR benchmark unchanged. N15 still off.
gate.qaoa: Same allocation, reported, not a substitute for the Nov3 gate.

ledger.new_charge: 64 fits times 3072 = 196608, all inside their own Q
